avl-check.name: AVL Check
avl-check.description: Check each proposed vendor on the requisition or draft against the approved-vendor list they exported.

backorder-list.name: Backorder List
backorder-list.description: Build a list of open lines past need-by, plus vendor backorder notes from the latest PDF or acknowledgment.

blanket-release.name: Blanket Release
blanket-release.description: Draft a release against the blanket log: keep the blanket number, remaining NTE or qty, release quantity, and the blanket price file.

change-order-pack.name: Change Order Pack
change-order-pack.description: Show the original PO line versus the requested change with the vendor PDF or buyer note that triggered it.

match.name: Match
match.description: Match PO lines to receiving and to the invoice PDF if present. Name any missing leg instead of calling the pack three-way.

open-pos.name: Open POs
open-pos.description: List open purchase orders and need-by dates from their sheet or export. Flag lines past need-by.

quote-lead-moq.name: Quote Lead MOQ
quote-lead-moq.description: Read the quote PDFs they saved. List unit price, currency, validity date, MOQ or pack, and lead time as written.

receiving-shorts.name: Receiving Shorts
receiving-shorts.description: From receiving versus open PO quantity, list shorts and partials. Do not write received-in-full.

rfq-from-files.name: RFQ From Files
rfq-from-files.description: Assemble the item list, quantities, specs or drawings they attached, and need-by from their requisition files.
